title: Ads
content:
# Ads

Managed ads bill per active ad per month across all 9 ad platforms, with 500 free and no percentage of ad spend.

## Price

<span id="managed-ads" />

| Meter | Included | Then |
|---|---|---|
| Managed ads | 500 active ads | $0.01 per active ad per month ($10 per 1,000) |

Ads created or synced through the [Ads API](/ad-campaigns/list-ads) meter. One meter covers Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, X, OpenAI Ads, Reddit Ads and Microsoft Ads.

## What counts

An ad counts only while it is running or in review, the states Zernio syncs for you.

| Ad state | Bills? |
|---|---|
| Active (delivering) | Yes |
| In review | Yes |
| Paused, ended, completed, rejected, errored or deleted | No |

- Counted live and metered daily. Pause or end a campaign and its ads leave the meter the same day.
- There is no percentage of ad spend. A $5 per day ad and a $5,000 per day ad both cost $0.01 per month.
- Creation, boosting, editing, analytics, audiences, lead forms and conversions carry no separate charge.
- Ad accounts also count as [connected accounts](/pricing/social#what-counts-as-a-connected-account).

## Example

| Active ads under management | Monthly cost |
|---|---|
| 400 | Free |
| 1,000 | $5.00 |
| 5,000 | $45.00 |
| 50,000 | $495.00 |

## Limits

- **Per team.** The count spans every connected ad account and rolls up to the team owner's invoice.
- **No running count.** `GET /v1/ads?status=active` returns the active count in `pagination.total`, and `status=pending_review` the other billable state.
- **No card on file:** Zernio emails the team owner at 375 live ads. At 500, ad syncing and ad changes fail with `403`, code `ads_allowance_exceeded`.
- **Card on file:** nothing pauses.
- **Invoice line:** Managed Ads.
